tagline: For when you need a laugh during a hostage situation, this emergency clown nose is a lifesaver. Literally, it might distract the kidnapper long enough for you to escape.

title: Proton Pack for Adults
tagline: Because your 30s aren't complete without a $450 ghost-catching backpack for cosplay or that one weird cousin's birthday party.

title: Gnome from Hell
tagline: Because your neighbor’s perfectly manicured lawn deserves a touch of the apocalypse. This isn’t just a gnome—it’s a statement piece for the person who’s tired of boring garden decor. Imagine your guests’ faces when they spot this little undead fellow lurking among the petunias. Perfect for Halloween year-round or for signaling to the neighborhood that you’re not to be messed with.

title: Galactic Garbage Bags
tagline: For the 1% who need to pack their space socks, this $50k luggage set is a must. Imagine arriving on Mars with a lost suitcase – the ultimate intergalactic embarrassment.

title: Rave Cave for Sale
tagline: For the ultimate party animal who wants to throw a rave in their backyard, but also values confusing their neighbors and possibly getting noise complaints.

title: Dino Mitzvah Mayhem
tagline: Imagine explaining to your rabbi why a T-Rex is holding your Hanukkah candles. This $85 menorah is for when you want to add a dash of prehistoric chaos to your holiday traditions.

title: Cleopatra’s Backup Plan
tagline: When your cat finally decides to sit on your head during the Zoom meeting, this wig will make it look intentional. Perfect for Renaissance fairs, bad history teachers, or anyone who wants to channel their inner pharaoh while waiting for the subway. Just don’t blame us if people start offering you gold.

title: Beep Boop Bling
tagline: For the couple who met at a Star Wars convention and wants their love story to be as extra as a lightsaber duel. This R2-D2 engagement ring is perfect for proposing during a marathon of the prequels—just make sure she says 'yes' before Jar Jar shows up.

title: Phone in Your Pants
tagline: For when you want to literally answer the call of nature, these iPhone panties are a thing. Imagine being at a music festival, and your phone dies, but you have a spare in your underwear – it's a weird kind of freedom.

title: Cabbage Snuggle Buddy
tagline: For when you want to reenact the great cabbage patch wars of your childhood, but with more fiber and less dignity. Wrap yourself in this giant cabbage blanket and confuse your friends and family.

title: Skull Storage for Hoarders
tagline: For when you need to organize your collection of vintage taxidermy eyes, but your coffee table is already cluttered with last week's pizza boxes and that one weird cousin's art project.

title: Banana Boat: Air Edition
tagline: For when your regular banana boat just isn't dramatic enough. This flying version is perfect for those 'I'm not drunk, I'm just navigating' moments on your yacht. Bonus points if you can land it on a floating cocktail table without spilling your mimosa. Just don't ask how you'll explain it to the Coast Guard.

title: Sniff Your Way to Wakefulness
tagline: For those who’ve mastered the art of sleeping through blaring alarms and vibrating wristbands, this olfactory wake-up call delivers a whiff of reality. Picture your morning coffee aroma morphing into the scent of fresh-baked failure as you hit snooze for the 12th time. Now, instead of a jarring beep, you’ll be gently roused by the smell of regret—er, we mean, your chosen scent. Perfect for the chronic oversleeper who’s tired of apologizing to their boss.

title: Dino-Mite Fashion Disaster
tagline: For the office party where you want to be remembered, wear this $3,500 dinosaur costume and reenact the Mesozoic era in the break room.

title: Taste the Toolbox
tagline: For the DIY enthusiast who's also a chocolatier, these edible tools are perfect for when you need to eat your screwdriver after a long day of building something that didn't quite work out.

title: Ballsy Suds: The Rope Edition
tagline: For the guy who wants to keep his hygiene routine... *ahem* hanging around. Perfect for the bachelor pad bathroom where the soap always goes missing—now it’s attached to a rope, so you can yank it back from your roommate’s clutches. Bonus: it’s a conversation starter at the gym locker room. Just don’t ask us how that conversation goes.

title: Battery-Powered Blue Nostalgia
tagline: For when your therapist says 'express yourself' but your landlord says 'no laser beams in the apartment.' This Mega Man helmet isn't just a cosplay piece—it's a statement. Wear it while coding at 3 AM, and suddenly your debugging sessions feel like a boss battle. Just don't expect it to actually shoot lasers. (Or do? The description is suspiciously vague.)

title: Limb Upgrade for Nerds
tagline: For when you need to open tight jars and also reenact Star Wars in your kitchen, this bionic arm is a must. Because who needs opposable thumbs when you can have a lightsaber limb?

title: Catnip Cologne for Humans
tagline: For those nights when you want to smell like a freshly brushed kitten but also need to convince your date you're not a furry. Perfect for cat cafes, pet grooming salons, or that one friend who insists on sniffing your hair. Just don't blame us if you start meowing.

title: Glow-in-the-Dark Biker Coaster
tagline: For when your childhood obsession with neon bikes meets your adult need for motion sickness. Perfect for that one friend who insists they’re a 'cyberpunk enthusiast' but still gets scared on the teacups. Bonus: The inevitable light show when someone loses their phone on the track.

title: Dino Cluck Arms
tagline: Because your dinner party needed T-Rex arms holding chicken, now your guests will question your sanity and table settings.

title: Sleep Like a Jet
tagline: For the person who's always wanted to be crushed by the weight of their own wanderlust, this Boeing 747 engine bed is the perfect place to rest your head after a long day of pretending you're a pilot.

title: Frankly Ridiculous Furniture
tagline: Because your living room was missing a 7k hot dog, now you can lounge on a wiener. Imagine the look on your in-laws' faces when they come over for dinner.

title: Pup's Royal Throne
tagline: For the friend who's obsessed with their dog's bowel movements, this portrait is a must. Imagine the look on their face when they hang a customized picture of their pup on the toilet in their living room.

title: Weird Baby Trick
tagline: For that one aunt who insists on reenacting childbirth at family gatherings, the Birthie Stick is a thing. It's a stick. With a baby on it. Because, reasons.

title: T-Rex Takes Over Living Room
tagline: Imagine a dinner party where a rogue T-Rex crashes in, courtesy of your mischievous cousin with a remote control. This inflatable beast is the life of the party, or a relationship ender.

title: RoboCop: Your New Desk Buddy
tagline: For when your office needs a little more '80s cyberpunk vibe. Perfect for intimidating your coworkers during Zoom calls or scaring the cat away from your keyboard. Comes with a built-in coffee holder—because even crime-fighting cyborgs need caffeine. Just don't ask it to help with your TPS reports.

title: Gotham’s Finest (and Most Impractical) Headwear
tagline: Because nothing says 'I’m ready for a quiet night in' like strapping on a $300 piece of polycarbonate and foam. Perfect for when your neighbor’s cat won’t stop yowling at 3 AM—just turn on the voice modulator and threaten to send them to Arkham. Bonus: it’s the only helmet that comes with its own existential crisis.
